player_prompt.intro:
E nyi Aɖewɔnɔ {player_id} to Wild Tic Tac Toe.
To kɛji ɖe, e na ɖo 'X' kɛji 'O' to kɛji ɖo.
E wɔ na ɖo to kɛji tɔn kɛji ɖo (X kɛji O) to kɛji ɖo.
E na ɖo kɛji ɖo to kɛji tɔn.
Na yi '[X 4]' ɖɔnɔ to kɛji X to kɛji ɖo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛji ɖɔnɔ wɔ na ɖɛ. Na yi '[X 4]' kɛji '[O 2]' ɖɔnɔ.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Hɔn nú ɔ́ nyí nùɖé ǎ: {cell}. É ɖó ná ɖò 0 kpo 8 kpán tɛntin.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Hɔn ɖ'ayi mɛ. Azinkpo {cell} ɔ ko ɖo azɔmɛ => Celle est déjà occupée.

game_action.placed: Aɖewɔnɔ {player_id} wɔ na ɖo ({mark}) to kɛji {cell}
